common_rule: 18 Luna high routes,6 T/6 F/6 U;36 opposing Luna high critics;3 Sol high adjudicators and1 Sol high synthesis. Exact ordinary lower-region primary unchanged. Root candidates and independent preparation audits are challengeable inputs, not authority. No extra agents, Lean builds or background jobs in routes. Six cycles maximum. Current registry428,96 exact refutation fences. First-shell formally verified; T_m all-m candidate remains OPEN pending this cycle.

routes.F1: Adversarial attack on uniform T_m candidate: polynomial factors, Poisson versus finite-order ULC, derivative bounds, Cauchy-Binet signs, 27 falling-factorial indices, all finite endpoints and graph selector bridge. Seek an exact failed inequality or independently justified survival. Probe large-m boundary analytically; evidence grade remains computer-assisted unless kernel checked.
routes.F2: Attack the heterogeneous extension, especially mixture curvature, unequal branch profiles, fixed versus changing selector, arity endpoints and proposed common minors. Use exact realizable graphs and state whether a failed intermediate refutes only the mechanism or full S. F_7 already fails Poisson ULC; do not rediscover that known fence as novelty.
routes.F3: Stress selected matching-slack or neighborhood budgets on asymmetric trees with proper favorable selectors if possible. Record exact Q,E,C,U,S,i_x,i_(x+1) and all original leaf deltas for every decisive witness. C must be computed inside each H_v, retaining the deleted leaf/support; C4-F3 omitted that deletion and gave wrong E/C.
routes.F4: Target a proper-selector witness (at least one favorable and one nonfavorable original leaf) in the eligible lower region, using known non-log-concave-tree constructions or heterogeneous gluing rather than more generic Pruefer samples. Give full graph, alpha,x,p, all selectors, all terms and S. If none found, exact search limits only; do not infer universal all-leaf selection.
routes.F5: Attack an explicitly specified mixed-boundary/unsigned-map candidate, preferably on asymmetric CB or T_m controls. A negative global sum does not settle Hall cuts. Produce an exact kernel, deficient cut, or rigorously lifted orbit certificate for the actual relation. Do not treat deletion-sector shortfall as a full-network refutation.
routes.F6: Try to refute the actual pointwise shell sign or a concrete low-cover sufficient inequality in the unresolved small-rank third shell. The cover>=7 shortcut is already false at the known order24 tree, while its S remains negative. Supply exact full selectors and distinguish pointwise failure from aggregate failure.
routes.T1: Uniform T_m candidate: independently prove or repair the central LC/mixed-minor argument and exact family consequence. Seek a shorter fully algebraic certificate or substantially smaller finite base. Do not assume the root or Sol audit is right; isolate every imported theorem and selector rank. Deliver an all-m proof or a precise gap, not a new larger sample.
routes.T2: Heterogeneous branches: derive a provable extension to bounded arities2..4 using star-factor ULC and the distributed marked-polynomial construction. Target a complete tractable infinite subfamily or an effective sufficiently-many-branches theorem with explicit finite debt. Prove both original selectors. Positive sums of LC sequences are not automatically LC.
routes.T3: Selected matching-slack charging: fix a maximum matching M and use L_B-nu(J_B)=u_M(N(B))+b_M(N(B))-|M intersect E(J_B)|. Find a non-tautological across-tag charging bound reaching Dext+C >= (alpha-2p+1)Q on a genuinely new class beyond n<=2p+2, or a concrete counterexample to a proposed sufficient bound. Preserve original weights.
routes.T4: Exact selector propagation under a concrete graph operation. Prove a nontrivial closure/exclusion theorem for the fixed strict favorable-leaf selector, or define a complete boundary-state invariant sufficient for that theorem. Rooted polynomial identities alone are already known. Check roots that are original leaves and same-support multiplicities.
routes.T5: Construct a specific unsigned cross-tag linear map or enlarged matching relation and establish a substantive rank/capacity theorem on a new class. The signed face-only retagging operator is refuted; unsigned blockwise injection also fails at T22. Name basis, weights, arcs, and mechanism fully. Generic structural rank does not imply rank of fixed entries.
routes.T6: Corrected six-cover skeleton or marked shell theorem: advance a genuine pointwise/sign argument beyond the already awarded first shell, prioritizing third-shell small-rank low-cover obstruction. Use corrected product over c not in I, not c outside N[I]. Preserve original leaves among cover vertices. No large uncontrolled census.
routes.U1: T_m certificate minimization and transfer scope: separate central-only LC from crossing minors, derive a reusable perturbation theorem with explicit constants and a minimal set of finite checks. Determine exactly which conclusion follows without P no-recovery. A symbolic certificate that reduces formal proof debt is preferred to mere restatement.
routes.U2: Construct a uniform coefficient certificate for products of bounded-arity star factors. Check lower coefficient estimates, exact alpha/order window, redistribution weights, and all source domains. Resolve one real analytic inequality enabling T2 or give an exact obstruction. Avoid enumerating an unbounded profile box.
routes.U3: Analyze structural decomposition of matching slack and first-descent data. Use alternating paths, component forests, or a potential with an explicit local transformation and global invariant. Extract a useful inequality rather than renaming addability; explain how positive T22 arm tags receive compensation.
routes.U4: Original-selector interface: seek the precise weakest transfer between Delta_x(T)<0 and later leaf-deletion coefficients. Use primary literature only with an exact hypothesis bridge. Supply one proved restricted lemma, an exact counterexample to a proposed closure, or a sharply stated irreducible obstruction. Do not assume forest unimodality or no-recovery.
routes.U5: Colored matching-sector boundary with competing capacities: use ordinary shadow plus actual support insertion/deletion exits. Derive one complete cut inequality or rigorously valid compression lemma on a specified sector class. Full-source counts, total capacity and qualitative topology alone are insufficient. Clarify relation to the independently audited signed-map obstruction.
routes.U6: Uniform marked-shell reduction with sharp rank gates and exceptional residuals. Identify a reusable reduction or a small complete family certificate which adds a new proven range. First-mark differences are Delta_(j-2), earlier marks are removed as vertices, generic thresholds do not silently cover specialized p6. Keep formal and informal scopes separate.
